objective: Stop Community Wall posts jumping during photo decode, late multi-photo hydration and recent-comment preview loading without changing native ads or protected Genesis staging behavior.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main source 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f; known already published Genesis R4 staging source 7bbb44fcb331ce14785ce43d70969d955f9e61e7. Neither existing staging nor production is changed by this DEV branch.
chosenApproach: Apply small isolated feed-only stable media geometry switches to shared CommunityPhotoCollage, opt in for Public and scoped Wall only, and reserve pending latest-comment preview height based on authoritative comment count. Keep existing FlashList scroll anchoring policy and AdMob SDK untouched.
selectionRationale: Photo onLoad previously changed card height from 310 to decoded aspect-dependent size; late 1-to-many photo metadata also changed a card from 310 to 280. Latest-comment RPC injected additional row content after first paint. A bounded feed-only frame and pending preview slot remove those two deterministic layout reflows without pausing media hydration, changing media authorization, modifying AdMob inventory, or replacing the consolidated Genesis source.
preserveBehaviors: Public, Organization and Cluster media remains private/signed, full image available and tap-to-view unchanged.
Composer, post detail and full-screen viewers retain original source aspect layout; only the scrollable Wall opts into fixed feed framing.
Existing FlashList and FlatList keys, pagination, pull refresh and focus transitions stay unchanged.
All ad unit IDs, consent, eligibility, preload, native/banner fallback, lifecycle, viewability/impressions and no-fill logic are untouched.
Comment RPC, reply permissions, counts, ordering, actions, cache and latest preview hydration remain unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Focused Node regression contracts pass for public/scoped media height, comment preview footprint and unchanged list/ad wiring.
Engineering Accountability objective-scope, protected feature locks and navigation/media regression gates pass on exact PR head.
Native Android device verifies photo and comment scroll stability under slow network, with video first-frame and all AdMob fill/impression gates before any consolidated staging release.
No build/new native or staging/production OTA is authorized by this intake PR; continue PR #1074 hold until all independent blockers resolve.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Reserve Community Wall photo and comment layout before media and recent-preview hydration while preserving feed runtime behavior.
preservedBehaviors: Unchanged video, photo, reactions, comments, ad SDK, navigation, account isolation and backend authorization.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Pinned media frame in Wall feeds prevents image decode and one-to-many metadata hydration from shifting the scroll viewport.
preservedBehaviors: Original authorized pixels remain available uncropped and full-screen; photo upload, caching, signed URL and quality paths are unchanged.

preservedBehaviors: Existing pull refresh, pagination, profile navigation, deep linking, account isolation, and ad/video scroll viewability are unchanged.

preservedBehaviors: Organization and Cluster memberships, RLS, post permissions, events, Bible and scope feed logic remain unchanged.

alternativeApproaches: Enable FlashList maintainVisibleContentPosition globally (rejected: conflicts with existing explicit regression contracts and unverified AdMob scrolling behavior).
Block Wall first paint until all photo and comment metadata resolves (rejected: unacceptable weak-network latency).
Expand or collapse NativeAd SDK pending slots (deferred: potentially harms ad fill and first-view rendering, requires separate ad QA).
releaseTarget: next verified full Genesis staging RC
